title: Creature Tracks: Pygmy!
description: Creature Tracks: Pygmy! — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Fiery Pygmy Tracks

Quest Type: Find and Kill

Quest Description: Explore the Ruins of Castle Caninenstein and find 3 more sets of Pygmy tracks. Then kill the Head Pygmy.

Quest Reward: 5,000 Gold and 1 Kings Coin.

Return to: Soldier Clohz

Repeatable: Yes - Repeat quests are from Soldier Clohz, not Fiery Pygmy Tracks, but strangely for less gold.
